putting s=0

which is the desired condition.

pp:ec:2008:q25.question: The recursion relation to solve $x=e^{-x}$ using Newton - Raphson method is

detailed_solution.markdown:

$x=e^{-x}$

Which can be rewritten as

$$\begin{array}{l} f(x)=x-e^{x}=0 \\ f^{\prime}(x)=1+e^{-x} \end{array}$$

$$\begin{aligned} x_{n+1}&=x_{n}-\frac{f\left(x_{n}\right)}{f^{\prime}\left(x_{n}\right)}\\ f\left(x_{n}\right)&=x_{n}-e^{-x_{n}} \\ f^{\prime}\left(x_{n}\right) &=1+e^{-x_{n}} \\ \therefore \quad x_{n+1} &=x_{n}-\frac{x_{n}-e^{-x_{n}}}{1+e^{-x_{n}}} \\ &=\frac{e^{-x_{n}} x_{n}+e^{-x_{n}}}{1+e^{-x_{n}}} \\ &=\left(1+x_{n}\right) \frac{e^{-x_{n}}}{1+e^{-x_{n}}} \end{aligned}$$

Therefore, the correct answer is **C**.
